title: add retry budget to job runner
author: jdoe
body:
## Summary
This PR introduces a retry budget for the job runner so failed jobs back off instead of hammering the queue.

## Changes
- Added a `RetryBudget` class that tracks attempts per job.
- Updated `j0` to consult the budget before retrying.
- Added comprehensive unit tests covering edge cases.

## Testing
- Ran the full test suite locally and all tests pass.
commits:
feat(jobs): add RetryBudget class

Introduce RetryBudget to cap the number of retries per job.

feat(jobs): use retry budget in j0

Update j0 to consult the budget before retrying a failed send.

test(jobs): add RetryBudget tests

Cover the retry limit, empty job ids and invalid limits.

refactor(jobs): tidy imports

Normalize quote style in the job runner.
